mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate level reflects tighter monetary policy, increasing equity discount rates and compressing valuation multiples, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that accelerate corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in > 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 320), the Federal Reserve typically initiates rate hikes, increasing equity discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of employment growth (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The positive correlation between PAYEMS and 5d SPX returns fails to hold in > 40% of time periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1450.0 thousand units signals weak residential construction activity, reducing consumer confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1450.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 320) signals stagflationary conditions that increase equity risk premiums and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 320 fails to predict negative returns in > 60% of cases over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales below 720,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue visibility and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS < 720000 over any 3-year rolling window.
